name: Wronged Monk's Wrath
disable: Irori Lore (trained) to clean the room and return the prayer items to their proper arrangement, DC 37 Religion (expert) to state an Iroran prayer of peace and put the haunt to rest, or DC 40 Occultism (master) to create a ward against future hauntings
reset: The haunt re-forms after 1 hour. The haunt becomes disabled and doesn't re-form if a creature lights all of the candles in the room and offers a prayer to Irori.

generalAbilities.name: Ki Storm
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the prayer room.

Effect The abbot's spirit appears and begins to channel powerful ki energy. One round later, the room fills with a powerful kinetic storm, dealing (3d10+15) Electricity Damage damage and (3d10+15) Force Damage damage to all creatures in the room. Creatures in the room must attempt a DC 37 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes Deafened for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage, 2d8 Persistent,electricity Damage damage, and becomes deafened for 1 minute.
